title: 第283章 骄蛮子庭外寻衅，莽大鹏按刀迎敌
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

日悬中天，风急尘起。

额尔木王宫粗木围栏之外。

岳大鹏领着二十名巡防营精骑，正松散地勒马候在场中。

弟兄们此刻见日头正暖，有几个老卒松了领口的甲扣，借着马腹的阴影躲凉。

忽然，东侧长街的木屋间传来一阵急促马蹄声。

岳大鹏巴掌下意识地摸上腰间刀柄，目光朝声音来处望去。

一队天狼骑兵，个个黑甲皮袍，满面风霜与怒气，一卷黑风般撞开街面，直逼王庭。

冲在最前头的一人，络腮胡遮了半边脸，左耳处戴着一枚铜环。

正是天狼使团的主使，忽都。

忽都昨日去札达部的草场查点贡马，本打算在草场消受两日，却收到暗报大宁边军入了额尔木城，只得率队疾驰而回。

数十骑在距离大宁军阵不足十步处，勒住缰绳。

战马吃痛，扬起前蹄发出一阵嘶鸣，前阵的飞尘尽数扑在巡防营骑兵的脸上。

忽都马鞭一指：“宁狗！这是哪阵风，把你们这帮藏在地洞里的老鼠吹到室韦来了？”

岳大鹏正牵着雪里青，被扑了一脸灰，啐了口唾沫，看清来人是天狼人，立刻回敬道：

“吹你爷爷的丧门风！怎么，平津的刀子没吃饱？你们这群没卵子的狗蛮子，老子还没去草原上找你们，你们倒自己送上门来领死了！”

话音未落，两人的战马似也察觉到了主人的火气，不安地踏着步子。

雪里青像是闻到了熟悉的草原同类气味，昂起马首。

它前蹄凌空乱踢，喉间爆出一声高亢穿云的烈嘶。

这声嘶鸣极具穿透力，在这剑拔弩张的阵前格外突兀。

忽都身侧的一名天狼百夫长闻声望去。

待看清白马的骨相与毛色，百夫长瞳孔剧震，指着雪里青失声大叫：

“大人！马！是特穆尔王子的雪里青！”

这一嗓子，如热油泼进了烈火。

“是三王子的坐骑！”

“宁狗抢了三王子的马！”

“宰了这些马贼，把马抢回来！”

天狼人向来视战马如命，何况这还是王子的绝世龙驹。

群情激愤之下，“哗啦”一阵金铁交击之声，几十名苍狼卫齐齐将弯刀抽出半鞘，满眼的凶光盯着岳大鹏。

巡防营这边，二十名精骑皆随周起历过战阵，一身是胆。

面对这几十天狼兵，无一人变色。长刀纷纷出鞘寸许，寒光对峙。

眼看便要在这王宫门前掀起一场血火，十数名负责守卫王庭的室韦士卒慌忙从栅栏后挤了出来。

他们举着长矛，战战兢兢地隔在两军之间，拿枪杆子横架在半空。

一名室韦校尉急得嗓音发颤：“使不得！两位将军，国主门前，使不得啊！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The sun is high in the sky, the wind is blowing and dust is rising.

Outside the rough wooden fence of Ermu Palace.

Yue Dapeng, leading twenty elite cavalrymen from the patrol battalion, was reining in their horses and waiting in the field.

The brothers saw that the sun was getting warm at this moment, and a few old soldiers loosened their collar buttons and took advantage of the shadow of the horse's belly to hide from the cold.

Suddenly, there was a rapid sound of horse hooves coming from the wooden houses on the long street on the east side.

Yue Dapeng subconsciously touched the handle of the knife at his waist and looked towards the source of the sound.

A group of Sirius cavalry, all wearing black armor and leather robes, their faces full of weather and anger, crashed through the street like a black wind, heading towards the royal court.

The person at the front had a beard covering half of his face and a copper ring on his left ear.

It was none other than the leader of the Sirius mission, Hudu.

Yesterday, Hudu went to the pasture of Zada ​​tribe to check the tribute horses. He planned to spend two days in the pasture, but he received a secret report that the Daning border army had entered Ermu City, so he had to lead his team to gallop back.

Dozens of riders were less than ten steps away from Daning's military formation, reining in their reins.

The war horse was in pain, raised its front hooves and neighed, and all the flying dust from the front line fell on the faces of the patrol battalion cavalry.

Suddenly he pointed his horse whip and said: "Ning Gou! What kind of wind is this that brings you mice hiding in the ground to Shiwei?"

Yue Dapeng was holding Xue Liqing. His face was dusted and he spat. When he saw clearly that the person coming was a Sirius, he immediately replied:

"You are bragging about your grandpa's death! Why, Pingjin's knives haven't had enough to eat? You bunch of eggless dog barbarians, I haven't even gone to the grassland to find you, but you have come to your door to pick you up yourself!"

Before they finished speaking, the two horses seemed to be aware of their master's anger and stepped uneasily.

Xue Liqing seemed to smell the familiar scent of the same grassland and raised his horse's head.

It kicked its front hooves in the air, and a high-pitched, cloud-piercing hiss burst from its throat.

This scream was extremely penetrating, and it was particularly abrupt in front of this tense formation.

A Sirius centurion beside Hudu heard the sound and moved away.

After seeing the bones and coat color of the white horse clearly, the centurion's pupils trembled sharply, he pointed at Xue Liqing and shouted:

"Sir! Ma! It's Prince Temur's Xue Liqing!"

This throat was like hot oil poured into a burning fire.

"It's the Third Prince's mount!"

"Ning Gou stole the third prince's horse!"

"Kill these horse thieves and get the horses back!"

Sirius people have always regarded war horses as their destiny, not to mention this is the prince's peerless dragon colt.

With the crowd agitated and angry, there was a sound of gold and iron clashing, and dozens of Canglang Guards unsheathed their scimitars in unison, staring at Yue Dapeng with fierce eyes.

In the patrol camp, the twenty elite cavalrymen all experienced battles with Zhou Qi and were full of courage.

Facing these dozens of Sirius soldiers, no one changed their color.The long knives were unsheathed one after another, and the cold light confronted each other.

Seeing that a bloody fire was about to start in front of the palace gate, more than a dozen Shiwei soldiers responsible for guarding the palace hurriedly squeezed out from behind the fence.

They held their spears and stood cautiously between the two armies, holding their gun barrels horizontally in the air.

A Shi Wei captain's voice trembled with anxiety: "You can't do it! You two generals, you can't do it in front of the king's door!"

title_en: Chapter 283 The arrogant barbarians are provoking a fight outside the court, and Mang Dapeng faces the enemy with his sword.
